title: A foreign mobile number copied from WhatsApp or Contacts is refused in setup
what: On Android, a number copied from WhatsApp or the contacts app often carries two invisible direction marks around it. The optional mobile box in setup keeps a foreign number exactly as pasted, marks included, and the check then says 'Enter 7 to 15 digits' for a correct number such as +44 7911 123456. An Indian number with the same marks is cleaned fine. Tried on the real cleaning code with the pasted value.
expected: Invisible marks are dropped from every number box, so a correct foreign number pasted in is accepted.
how_often: when they paste a copied number
fix_line: Drop invisible marks before the number is kept or checked

title: Join your gym promises a trainer's plan, but the test gym has no member with a trainer
what: The Join your gym screen says members will 'get your trainer's plan'. At the test gym Crispy Curves none of the 2 members has a trainer set, so a member who joins finds no trainer's plan. Nothing on the join path asks the gym to give a member a trainer.
expected: The words promise only what every joined member gets, or say 'if your gym gives you a trainer'.
how_often: every join at a gym without trainers set
fix_line: Soften the words to 'your trainer's plan, if your gym gives you one'
